newsitem.title: USA: Saliva Diagnostic sees Q2 shr loss down.
newsitem.headline: Saliva Diagnostic sees Q2 shr loss down.

text.p: Saliva Diagnostic Systems Inc said Wednesday it expects to record a smaller loss per share in the second quarter than the $0.05 per share it lost in the first quarter.
The improved earnings was led by record second quarter revenues, which it expects to be in the $380,000 to $400,000 range for the period ended June 30, the company said.
The company said orders for its HIV testing kits has grown but sales have been constrained by the limited production capacity at its Singapore plant.
The company said later this year it expects to clear U.S. regulatory hurdles that currently prevent it producing kits for export at its automated manufacturing facility in Vanouver, Wash.
